title: Akhri namaz
body:
Akhri namaz
Allah, allah allah..(6)
<<MINI>>
Yu akhri hussain ne sajda adaa kiya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jalti hui zamee'n ko..(2)
mo'alla bana diya
<<MINI>>
Yu akhri hussain ne sajda adaa kiya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Laashe jawa'n thi saamne ibne batool ke
seene se jo hata nahi akbar ke baad se
wo haath kaanpta hua takbeer ko utha
2. Takbeer sunke laasha e akbar tadap gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
tharra rahe the zauf se maula ke dast o paa
zakhmo se sheh ke aati thi al-hamd ki sadaa
3. Thi ghurbat e hussain par nabiyo ki bhi nazar
tuti kamar thi gham mein alamdaar ke magar
<<DIVIDER>>
tha haalat e qayaam mein zahra ka laadla
4. Rote the is khayal se maula qayaam mein
na mehramo ki bheed mein darbar e shaam mein
zainab khadi rahegi bhala kaise berida
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Yaad aagaya ruku mein beemar ka safar
zainab ki beridayi ke ghum mein jhukaye sar
darbaar tak ruku mein sajjad jayega
6. Masjid mein reh gaya tha jo ek sajda e ali
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal mein ibne zahra ne wo sajda aakhri
fuzto be rabbe kaabe ki tareekh mein kiya
7. Aayi jo aasmaan se awaaz e irji'ee
zainab ke sar se chadar e tatheer gir gayi
<<DIVIDER>>
sajde me sar tha shaah ka khanjar gale pe tha
